ranking.evidence: IoU=0.0, Dice=0.0. FoodUNet produces all-zero masks on every real image. Trained on 2 synthetic fixture samples.
ranking.impact: All downstream volume/mass estimation runs in pure bbox-fallback mode without food-pixel information.

ranking.evidence: R²=-118.7, MAE=353.9g. Neural mass regressor predicts ~2.7g for all inputs (fixture-trained). Physics fallback (vol×density) is now the operative path.
ranking.impact: Inaccurate mass → inaccurate calorie scaling in heuristic fallback.

ranking.evidence: R²<0 for all targets. Model predicts near-zero for all inputs (untrained on real images). Heuristic fallback (150kcal/100g) is now operative.
ranking.impact: Calorie/protein/carb/fat predictions are heuristic estimates, not model predictions.

ranking.evidence: Precision=0.006 (extremely low), Recall=1.0. Pretrained YOLOv8n detects all 80 COCO classes. After blacklist fix, only food-adjacent classes pass. No fine-tuning on food-specific datasets.
ranking.impact: May miss food items not in COCO 80-class vocab. Bounding boxes may not be tight around food.

ranking.evidence: Top-1=50% on fixture. Model has EfficientNet-B0 backbone with pretrained ImageNet weights — backbone should generalize if fine-tuned on Food101.
ranking.impact: Incorrect food class → wrong ingredient lookup → wrong reference nutrition profile.

root_cause: Insufficient training data. All models trained on 2-16 synthetic fixture samples which do not represent real food images.
recommendation: PRIMARY: Acquire and load at least one real food dataset (Nutrition5k or Food101). Even a small subset (100-500 real images) will dramatically outperform fixture-trained models. SECONDARY: Retrain segmenter with more epochs and augmentation on enlarged fixture. TERTIARY: Add cosine LR schedule and early stopping to all training pipelines.
